title: WRP Event
description: Base event contract for the WorkRequest Protocol. All WRP lifecycle events share this envelope. Compatible with the JSON-LD definition at schemas/ontology/core/event.jsonld.

wrp_id.description: WorkRequest ID this event belongs to

type.description: Event type — identifies the lifecycle event

version.description: Event schema version (additive only — never breaking)

causation_id.description: ID of the event that caused this event (causality chain)

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID grouping related events across WorkRequests

previous_status.description: Previous state before transition (for state-change events)

new_status.description: New state after transition (for state-change events)

reason.description: Reason for the transition (e.g., failure reason)

actor.description: Agent or system that triggered the event
